questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning beautiful writing?
explanation: Calligraphy is correct - C-A-L-L-I-G-R-A-P-H-Y. From Greek kallos meaning beauty and graphein meaning to write.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning relating to the sun?
explanation: Solar is correct - S-O-L-A-R. From Latin sol meaning sun. Solar means relating to or determined by the sun.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning love of mankind?
explanation: Philanthropy is correct - P-H-I-L-A-N-T-H-R-O-P-Y. From Greek philos meaning loving and anthropos meaning human.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to breathe?
explanation: Respiration is correct - R-E-S-P-I-R-A-T-I-O-N. From Latin respirare meaning to breathe. The process of breathing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning government by all the people?
explanation: Democracy is correct - D-E-M-O-C-R-A-C-Y. From Greek demos meaning people and kratos meaning power.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning a circular building?
explanation: Amphitheatre is correct - A-M-P-H-I-T-H-E-A-T-R-E. From Greek amphi meaning around and theatron meaning a viewing place.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning the study of the earth?
explanation: Geology is correct - G-E-O-L-O-G-Y. From Greek ge meaning earth and logos meaning study.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning a city state?
explanation: Municipality is correct - M-U-N-I-C-I-P-A-L-I-T-Y. From Latin municipium meaning a free city. Refers to a city or town with its own local government.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a type of single-celled organism?
explanation: Amoeba is correct - A-M-O-E-B-A. From Greek amoibe meaning change. An amoeba is a single-celled organism that changes shape.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning relating to a hundred?
explanation: Centennial is correct - C-E-N-T-E-N-N-I-A-L. From Latin centum meaning hundred and annus meaning year. Double N.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning the study of life?
explanation: Biology is correct - B-I-O-L-O-G-Y. From Greek bios meaning life and logos meaning study.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to flow across?
explanation: Transient is correct - T-R-A-N-S-I-E-N-T. From Latin transire meaning to go across. Means lasting only for a short time.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a record of all living things?
explanation: Taxonomy is correct - T-A-X-O-N-O-M-Y. From Greek taxis meaning arrangement and nomos meaning law. The classification of organisms.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning the power to choose?
explanation: Volition is correct - V-O-L-I-T-I-O-N. From Latin volitio meaning will. Volition means the faculty of making choices.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a lover of wisdom?
explanation: Philosopher is correct - P-H-I-L-O-S-O-P-H-E-R. From Greek philos meaning loving and sophos meaning wise.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning not in order?
explanation: Irregular is correct - I-R-R-E-G-U-L-A-R. From Latin irregularis. Double R after the prefix IR. Means not following rules.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning written with pictures?
explanation: Hieroglyphics is correct - H-I-E-R-O-G-L-Y-P-H-I-C-S. From Greek hieros meaning sacred and glyphe meaning carving.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning under the earth?
explanation: Subterranean is correct - S-U-B-T-E-R-R-A-N-E-A-N. From Latin sub meaning under and terra meaning earth. Double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning fear of closed spaces?
explanation: Claustrophobia is correct - C-L-A-U-S-T-R-O-P-H-O-B-I-A. From Latin claustrum meaning enclosed space and Greek phobos meaning fear.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a sound that echoes?
explanation: Reverberation is correct - R-E-V-E-R-B-E-R-A-T-I-O-N. From Latin reverberare meaning to beat back. Means an echoed sound.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning rule by priests?
explanation: Theocracy is correct - T-H-E-O-C-R-A-C-Y. From Greek theos meaning God and kratos meaning power. A system of government by priests.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to draw out?
explanation: Extract is correct - E-X-T-R-A-C-T. From Latin extractus meaning drawn out. To extract means to remove or take out.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning the study of words?
explanation: Lexicology is correct - L-E-X-I-C-O-L-O-G-Y. From Greek lexikon meaning of words and logos meaning study.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to pass on?
explanation: Transmit is correct - T-R-A-N-S-M-I-T. From Latin trans meaning across and mittere meaning to send.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a system of writing?
explanation: Orthography is correct - O-R-T-H-O-G-R-A-P-H-Y. From Greek orthos meaning correct and graphein meaning to write.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to strengthen?
explanation: Fortify is correct - F-O-R-T-I-F-Y. From Latin fortis meaning strong and facere meaning to make. To fortify means to make stronger.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning measurement of the earth?
explanation: Geometry is correct - G-E-O-M-E-T-R-Y. From Greek ge meaning earth and metron meaning measure.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to put together again?
explanation: Reconstitute is correct - R-E-C-O-N-S-T-I-T-U-T-E. From Latin re meaning again and constituere meaning to set up.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning without government?
explanation: Anarchy is correct - A-N-A-R-C-H-Y. From Greek an meaning without and arche meaning rule. Anarchy means absence of government.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to know beforehand?
explanation: Premonition is correct - P-R-E-M-O-N-I-T-I-O-N. From Latin prae meaning before and monere meaning to warn.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning writing about maps?
explanation: Cartography is correct - C-A-R-T-O-G-R-A-P-H-Y. From Latin charta meaning map and Greek graphein meaning to write.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to move away from?
explanation: Deviate is correct - D-E-V-I-A-T-E. From Latin deviare meaning to turn from the way. To deviate means to depart from an established course.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning of the sea?
explanation: Maritime is correct - M-A-R-I-T-I-M-E. From Latin maritimus meaning of the sea. Maritime means connected with the sea.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to speak against?
explanation: Contradict is correct - C-O-N-T-R-A-D-I-C-T. From Latin contra meaning against and dicere meaning to speak.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning the study of numbers?
explanation: Mathematics is correct - M-A-T-H-E-M-A-T-I-C-S. From Greek mathematike meaning things learned.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning equal justice?
explanation: Equity is correct - E-Q-U-I-T-Y. From Latin aequitas meaning equality. Equity means fairness and justice in the way people are treated.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a period of a thousand years?
explanation: Millennium is correct - M-I-L-L-E-N-N-I-U-M. From Latin mille meaning thousand and annus meaning year. Double L and double N.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning turning into stone?
explanation: Petrification is correct - P-E-T-R-I-F-I-C-A-T-I-O-N. From Greek petra meaning rock and Latin facere meaning to make.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning a person who leads?
explanation: Protagonist is correct - P-R-O-T-A-G-O-N-I-S-T. From Greek protos meaning first and agonistes meaning contestant. The main character.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning all powerful?
explanation: Omnipotent is correct - O-M-N-I-P-O-T-E-N-T. From Latin omnis meaning all and potens meaning powerful.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning government by the wealthy?
explanation: Plutocracy is correct - P-L-U-T-O-C-R-A-C-Y. From Greek ploutos meaning wealth and kratos meaning power. Rule by the wealthy.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning a written law?
explanation: Statute is correct - S-T-A-T-U-T-E. From Latin statutum meaning something set up. A statute is a written law passed by a legislature.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning first in time?
explanation: Primordial is correct - P-R-I-M-O-R-D-I-A-L. From Latin primus meaning first and ordiri meaning to begin. Means existing from the beginning.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning self governing?
explanation: Autonomous is correct - A-U-T-O-N-O-M-O-U-S. From Greek autos meaning self and nomos meaning law. Means self-governing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning beyond the normal?
explanation: Supernatural is correct - S-U-P-E-R-N-A-T-U-R-A-L. From Latin super meaning above and natura meaning nature.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning the study of the mind?
explanation: Psychology is correct - P-S-Y-C-H-O-L-O-G-Y. From Greek psyche meaning mind and logos meaning study. The P is silent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning to put in order?
explanation: Organise is correct - O-R-G-A-N-I-S-E. From Greek organon meaning instrument. To organise means to arrange in a systematic way.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Latin meaning under the authority of?
explanation: Subordinate is correct - S-U-B-O-R-D-I-N-A-T-E. From Latin sub meaning under and ordinare meaning to order.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning across the earth?
explanation: Transcontinental is correct - T-R-A-N-S-C-O-N-T-I-N-E-N-T-A-L. From Latin trans meaning across and continens meaning containing land.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word from Greek meaning a person who is against authority?
explanation: Anarchist is correct - A-N-A-R-C-H-I-S-T. From Greek an meaning without and arche meaning rule. An anarchist opposes organized government.
